answer: An agent economy can require every participant to bond scarce tokens before receiving jobs, then randomly audit its claims through repeated, independently chosen peer challenges. A false identity that fabricates an echo, such as a raven report or a fable, risks forfeiting its bond when honest agents expose inconsistent evidence; splitting into many accounts therefore multiplies the collateral required and the expected slashing loss. The attacker pays upfront capital and must keep risking it, making cheap Sybil swarms uneconomic.
